anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly higher than the number of cores, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles or opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation.
Review and potentially restart AI processes to ensure they are functioning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are actively engaging in trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU-intensive processes and consider load balancing or scaling resources.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to performance issues and affect trading operations.

recommendations.action: Restart or debug the AI module to ensure it is operational and generating trading opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Review trading strategy configurations and ensure they are set up correctly to engage in trades.
recommendations.rationale: No active trades or profit/loss indicates potential misconfiguration or inactive trading strategies.
